name: SealReply Live Chat
author: contentforgecms

sections.description:
SealReply adds a live chat button to your WordPress site so visitors can ask questions while they are deciding to buy. You answer from the SealReply console in your browser or from the SealReply mobile app.

  • Free plan with no time limit: no credit card or payment details needed.
  • Set up in a minute: click Connect, sign up or sign in, and the chat button appears. No code to paste.
  • Never miss a visitor: push notifications on your phone, and visitors can leave their email when you are away.
  • Fast and light: the chat loads after your page, in its own isolated layer, so it does not slow your site or clash with your theme.
  • Works with WooCommerce and any theme or page builder.
  • Speaks your visitors’ language: the chat window follows the visitor’s language, and Pro and Business plans translate messages both ways.

Appearance, greetings, working hours, quick replies and your team are all set in the SealReply console. This plugin only connects your site and adds the chat button.

External services

This plugin connects your website to SealReply, a live chat service run by SealReply. It is needed to show the chat and deliver messages.

  • On every page of your website, visitors’ browsers load the chat script from https://cdn.sealreply.com/widget.js. The chat then talks to https://api.sealreply.com and wss://ws.sealreply.com. It sends your site key, the page address and title, the visitor’s browser language and type, and whatever the visitor types or uploads in the chat. Nothing is sent from pages where the chat is hidden, or before the plugin is connected.
  • When you click Connect, your browser opens https://app.sealreply.com with your website’s address, its name and the address of this settings page, so that SealReply can create or find your site and send its site key back here.

SealReply Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add Plugin, search for “SealReply”, click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings → SealReply Live Chat and click “Sign up free and connect” (or “Sign in and connect” if you already have an account).
  3. You are sent back to WordPress, connected. A new account gets its site created for you; if your account already has sites, pick the one for this website.
  4. Open your website once. The chat button appears and your domain is verified automatically.

Reply to visitors at https://app.sealreply.com or in the SealReply app.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The Free plan has no time limit and needs no payment details. Paid plans add more agents, websites, monthly chats and features. See https://www.sealreply.com/pricing.

Where do I answer visitors?

In the SealReply console (https://app.sealreply.com) or the SealReply mobile app. The plugin does not add a chat inbox to the WordPress admin.

The chat button does not show.

Check that the plugin is connected and the chat is not hidden on its settings page, then open your website once while not in maintenance mode. If your site is behind a login, a “coming soon” page or a firewall that blocks unknown visitors, verify your domain in the SealReply console with a DNS record or a file instead.

Can I connect a local or staging site?

Connecting needs a public domain. On a local site, copy the site key from the SealReply console and paste it under “Enter the site key by hand”.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The chat script loads asynchronously and is under 50 KB compressed.
